The canonical methods library is the primary content of this site. Each family
page links directly to the maintained source under `templates/`.

::: {.callout-note}
## Template status

The current inventory contains 37 canonical templates: 34
`SOURCE-BACKED WORKFLOW` pages and 3 `API / TUTORIAL REMINDER` pages. All are
currently `draft`; parsing or rendering documentation does not make a workflow
scientifically validated.
:::

::: {.grid}
